title: Branch breakage: rust lichen-schc lib tests fail to compile - Ipv6Addr::from_str without FromStr import in cfg(test)
description: P1 branch health, found while running gates for project-LICHEN-worker6-hahk on heft (worker5). On beads-worker-5 HEAD 8b07985284: cargo test -p lichen-schc --lib fails to compile with 6x E0599 no associated function or constant named from_str found for struct core::net::Ipv6Addr at rust/lichen-schc/src/codec.rs:2837, 2840, 2868, 2871, 2887, 2890 (cfg(test) code, likely from the ow1e.111 Ipv6Addr newtype refactor). The LIB itself builds (cargo build -p lichen-schc passes); only the test profile breaks, so cargo test -p lichen-schc is dead and nyx7-adjacent direct-call test work cannot run until fixed. Fix: add use core::str::FromStr (or Ipv6Addr::new literals) in the test module, then run cargo test -p lichen-schc --lib and cargo clippy --all-features -p lichen-schc -- -D warnings. Note for heft workers: the workspace rust/Cargo.toml:57 pins oscore to a macOS path /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/oscore; on heft redirect to /home/mark/crates/oscore via a scratch worktree (do not commit the path change).
